core_obligations: Reduce to flat modules (proof lines 10836-10845): since L pi_! commutes with colimits it suffices to treat bounded above complexes, which are quasi-isomorphic to bounded above complexes with flat terms, so it suffices to prove the statement for a flat A_bullet-module F.

Use the computation procedures (proof lines 10846-10850): for a flat module the derived tensor product is the ordinary one and still a sheaf, so the computation lemmas express the cohomology sheaves of both sides through the fibres of the simplicial category.

Conclude on the fibre categories (proof lines 10851-10853): it remains to prove the statement for the restriction of F to the categories Delta x U, where it is the auxiliary computation for a single object, which gives the result.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a flat module over the simplicial sheaf of rings.
Express both sides through the computation lemmas for the lower shriek.
Apply the auxiliary computation on the fibre categories.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that an isomorphism L pi_!A_bullet = L pi_!B_bullet implies a base change formula for the lower shriek after extending scalars (statement lines 10822-10833). The proof (proof lines 10835-10853) reduces to a flat module over the simplicial sheaf of rings, computes both sides through the two computation lemmas for the lower shriek, and finishes with the auxiliary computation on the fibre categories. H2: one reduction plus one localisation to fibres, written out.
